decisions.reason: As a small accessory closely tied to the core trailer business, it is inexpensive to keep on offer while the firm learns about demand.
This homepage-promoted box trailer line fits the firm's main capabilities and market, so management would likely keep the option open for another year.

The car transporter trailer line is more specialized and was less prominently featured, which raises uncertainty and carrying costs, but after only one year there is still value in waiting for clearer signals.
The low-bed trailer series is a core-type product for a trailer maker and its homepage visibility suggests the firm sees enough promise to continue.
As a complementary cover series that supports existing trailer sales, it likely costs little to maintain and strengthens the broader product offering.
